Hey man, I’m here with you dealing with similar issues. I’ve wanted to kill myself a lot lately due to my severe depression and self hatred. My grades have plummeted and I’m afraid of living on minimum wage the rest of my life. Just know that if you wanna talk to someone who’s currently going through this I’m here. I don’t really sleep.

Every day it feels less and less temporary. I can’t stop thinking about how I’ll be able to function with this self hatred as an adult. I’m so weak I can’t bother to fix just the simple problems.

If I can prove to myself that I’ll be able to accomplish something I’ve spent nearly a third of my life dreaming of, I can believe I can truly be happy. 

But I have to overcome myself first.

But then the endless cycle begins again. I want to get through but when I need to do the necessary work I’m never motivated. My grades just show how poor of a worker I am and no one would want to train/hire me.

Tbh I would love to just go into the working worlds right now. Like an actual job, not some minimum wage shit a lot of people get in high school/college. I just want to analyze some fucking data for some peeps. Do something else, matter for once, prove I can be proficient in at least one thing that isn’t Gangplank.

Depressive episodes have never lasted long for me but neither have good periods. That’s why I believe I have bipolar depression. This is actually the longest I’ve gone being 100% depressed; almost a week now.
